page.layout: One page of text, one column, centred at the head with running head and page number; below the letter a small heading (EPIST. LXXX.), an indented summary line, the date line, and a catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.l: è Pentateucho latinè, si fieri posset,
ab aliquo Syro latinæ lingvæ perito
melius judicari possit; iterum à te expo-
stulo pauca quædam, quæ ad Samaritanam
ad me mitti, ut mihi sint velut præludia
amplioris messis expectatæ; hæc si con-
cesseris non modo me, sed & Remp. lite-
liariter tibi scribo, pluraque quàm petierim
quòd tam liberaliter in se laudes conjecerit.

page.notes: The word "Ee" in the signature is doubtful. The catchword "Ad-" is printed at the right foot. The page number 591 is printed at the top right. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, and qv is read as qu where the v is a vowel.
